svg.title: Commit activity, last 30 days: 52 commits on 7 of the last 30 days
svg.desc: Column chart drawn as petals, one per day from 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-27; height is the number of commits to public repositories. Days with commits: 3 Nov: 23, 4 Nov: 10, 7 Nov: 5, 8 Nov: 1, 10 Nov: 2, 15 Nov: 9, 17 Nov: 2.

g.text: 52 commits on 7 of the last 30 days. One petal per day; its height is
